title: A Different Kind of Hungary (Egy sajátos magyar világ)
grammar: Words for Books and Schools: -ként, nyomda, zsoltár

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who made the first complete Hungarian Bible and where it was printed.
I can discuss Károli Gáspár's Vizsoly Bible and Albert Szenczi Molnár's psalm translations.
I can say in what role a person became known with -ként (a fordítójaként).
I can answer simple questions about the books and schools of 16th-17th century Transylvania and the Tiszántúl.
